description: Prepare and release version 0.3.17 of the community library. This involves updating the library's version metadata and synchronizing the dependency lock file to reflect the new release state.
functional_requirements: Update the version number in the library's project configuration file to '0.3.17'.
Generate or update the dependency lock file to ensure it is consistent with the declared dependencies for the new version.
Ensure the release process does not introduce any changes to the actual library code or its functional dependencies.
